review_type: independent read-only leakage and matching review

checks.cost_api: pair_controls receives only current query weights, one candidate initialization, and query-only masks; no run IDs or true-parent index
checks.all_pair_treatment: the same nested pair_controls call fills all 100 cells; no diagonal branch or replacement
checks.activity_mask_source: only the current query hidden activation occupancy on the original fixed probe; original activation archive SHA256 and run mapping checked
checks.activity_invariance: Pr(H>0) is invariant to positive ReLU scaling; permutations carry the query mask with its neurons
checks.masked_assignment: full squared joint-neuron cost includes candidate squared norms, then zeroes unselected query rows; exact shared Hungarian assignment
checks.residual_masks: small/large quantile selection is recomputed from each current-query/candidate pair after shared matching, not from the known true-parent residual
checks.historical_changes: same-run initial/current changes are exported only after retrieval costs; the historical table is never an input to masks or costs
checks.boundary_ties: all quantile boundary ties are included; saved counts document potentially larger and overlapping subsets
checks.coordinate_controls: identity-coordinate variants are intentionally not neuron-permutation invariant and are marked as coordinate-memory diagnostics
checks.primary_regression: build rechecks the validated Point 1 file hash, run ordering, and exact normalized canonical total-cost reproduction
checks.point1_completion_guard: build requires the finalized Point 1 artifact manifest and validated distance source before execution

interpretation_limits: Candidate-specific residual selection is a metric-sensitivity analysis, not removal of the true historical training change or a causal ablation.
Low/high activity masks can overlap when occupancy ties span quantile boundaries; they need not select exactly 25 percent.
Globally normalized layer and masked distances are contributions to one jointly normalized weight vector, not separately unit-normalized subvector distances.
Original run seeds determine both initialization and minibatch order.
